crossRefs.note: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
They immediately left their nets and followed him.
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”
Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have, and give to the poor…
Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or…
but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land…
However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…

translations.web: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
translations.bsb: And when they had brought their boats ashore, they left everything and followed Him.
translations.kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
translations.asv: And when they had brought their boats to land, they left all, and followed him.
